items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Miss Robin said to the little one... I was in the weather strutting my stuff.

ctx.x: One day the sun was warm and bright, no clouds seen in the sky. Miss Robin said to the little one, it's time you all should fly. And every little Robin said to Mom, I'll try, I'll try, I'll try. Sure I know the child and the good one, so I'll try.

Tell you all by and by. But you got to fly, fly, fly, fly. Every little one got to fly high. Fly, fly, fly high. Before mother die. It was well as winter when time was rough. I was in the weather strutting my stuff. So fly, fly, fly, fly. Every little one got to fly high.
